subject: Science
title: Class 9 Science Olympiad — Paper 1
instructions: The time allowed for this paper is 60 minutes.
This paper contains 50 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions carrying a total of 60 marks.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
Each question has four options; choose the one correct answer.
Section 1 and other regular sections carry 1 mark per question; the Achievers Section carries 3 marks per question.
Use of calculators is not permitted unless specified.

questions.question: Arrange in order of increasing size: Molecule, Atom, Electron, Cell
A is north of B. C is east of B. What direction is C from A?
If EAST becomes WEST when reflected, what does NORTH become?
A clock shows 4:30. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
Find the next term: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, __ (Fibonacci pattern)
If '+' means 'x', 'x' means '-', '-' means '÷', evaluate: 6 + 2 x 3
Complete the analogy: Thermometer is to Temperature as Barometer is to ____
A is the son of B. B is the sister of C. How is A related to C?
Find the missing number: 2, 5, 10, 17, __
Find the odd one out: Frog, Fish, Whale, Crocodile

Which of these best describes a colloid?
options: A mixture where particles settle quickly
A pure substance with fixed composition
A mixture where particles are larger than in a solution but do not settle, e.g., milk
A mixture where components are completely separated

questions.question: According to Newton's third law, for every action there is a reaction that is:
options: Equal in magnitude and same direction
Equal in magnitude and opposite in direction

options: The helium balloon rises because helium is less dense than air, so the buoyant force exceeds its weight

questions.question: A tuning fork produces sound with a frequency of 15 Hz. Why can't a human hear this sound?
options: 15 Hz is too loud for the human ear
15 Hz is below the audible range for humans (20 Hz to 20,000 Hz), so it is infrasonic
The tuning fork does not vibrate at all
All frequencies are audible to humans

questions.question: A student pushes a heavy box but it does not move despite applying force. Explain using Newton's laws why no work is done in the physics sense.
options: Work is zero because there is no displacement, even though force is applied
Work cannot be determined without knowing the box's mass
Work is done because force was applied

questions.question: Comparing crop rotation with monoculture farming, what long-term advantage does crop rotation offer for soil health?
options: It always produces higher yields in a single season
It eliminates the need for fertilizers entirely
It helps replenish soil nutrients and reduces pest/disease buildup by varying crops
It has no measurable impact on soil quality

questions.question: If the number of neutrons in an atom is changed while the number of protons stays the same, what results?
options: A different element with the same atomic number
An isotope of the same element is formed
